headline: Brief Reports Two Offshore Weather Systems as Habagat Persists
seoTitle: Brief: PAGASA Offshore Systems and Habagat Outlook
seoDescription: An FMB News evening brief reports two offshore weather disturbances and an extended Habagat outlook for western sections of the Philippines.
deck: The August 15 newsroom package reports continuing monsoon influence while offshore disturbances are monitored.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The FMB News brief reports that PAGASA was monitoring two systems outside PAR and that monsoon-related rainfall could persist through August 23.

FMB News could not independently retrieve the exact August 15 operational PAGASA bulletin establishing both systems and the August 23 validity period. The system count, labels and end date are therefore source-attributed rather than presented as a confirmed current warning.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: This is an archived time-stamped weather report, not a current warning for August 17.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Weather outlooks affect travel, fishing, agriculture and flood preparedness, but operational advisories must be tied to the correct issuance time.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Readers should rely on the latest PAGASA public-weather forecast and tropical-cyclone bulletins for actionable conditions.
